structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A registers System-B in its own list of downstream systems (administrative inclusion) and System-C registers an interest to receive notifications from the Reporting flow (passive consumption).
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: 'System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems' replaced with 'System-A registers System-B in its own list of downstream systems (administrative inclusion)'.
AMB-02 resolved: 'allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow' replaced with 'System-C registers an interest to receive notifications from the Reporting flow (passive consumption)'.
